basis: Skeletal anomalies and impaired intellectual development define the syndrome.
Inherited peripheral demyelinating neuropathy; scoliosis reported in 30-79%. Neurogenic weakness alone adds no muscle axis; hearing and respiratory complications <30%.
Mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation disorder; decreased liver function reported in 1/1 annotated patients, with limited sample size.
Malignant adipose tissue tumour arising in the intracranial compartment.
Inherited multiple cutaneous keratoacanthomas with ulceration and hyperkeratosis; mucosal involvement is not characteristic.
Cerebral cortical malformations caused by abnormal neuronal migration define this spectrum.
Cerebellar and brainstem hypoplasia define PCH12. Individual skeletal abnormalities occur in 1/4 patients, below threshold.
Cobalamin metabolic defect; intellectual disability/developmental delay 30-79%. Renal insufficiency <30%; hepatomegaly and crisis-related breathing changes lack intrinsic organ damage.
Low-grade neoplasm of CNS ependymal cells.
Respiratory syndrome classified here under hypersensitivity pneumonitis, with allergic airway manifestations. Headache, dry skin and mucosal irritation do not establish organ damage.
Malignant brain tumour with glial and sarcomatous differentiation; mesenchymal histology does not imply skeletal involvement.
IFNGR2-related primary immunodeficiency with susceptibility to mycobacterial infections; no common intrinsic organ damage documented.
Cardiac, pericardial, sternal and diaphragmatic defects define syndrome; pulmonary hypoplasia 30-79%. Omphalocele is an abdominal wall defect, not intrinsic bowel damage.
Ovarian reproductive tissue malignancy; no endocrine dysfunction or common damage to an included organ established.
Infantile T-cell lymphopenia defines the blood/immune disorder; nail dystrophy in 10/25 (40%). Pneumonia in 20% does not support pulmonary involvement.
Brain atrophy and developmental impairment; gingival overgrowth and scoliosis each 30-79%. Visual dysfunction is mainly central; intrinsic eye abnormalities are <30%.
Defining lung disease and T-cell immunodeficiency; eczematoid dermatitis in 2/4 (50%). Cerebral calcification alone does not establish neurologic dysfunction.
Usually infectious inflammation of the larynx and trachea; infectious ancestry supports the mechanism axis.
Spondylometaphyseal skeletal dysplasia with bowed forearms; no additional organ damage established.
Cancer originates in upper gingiva, which belongs to the oral gastrointestinal axis; jaw invasion is not established.
Cancer susceptibility, principally involving breast, which has no axis. Neuroblastoma is a later risk, not existing neurologic damage.
Malignant smooth muscle tumour arising in bone; an EBV-associated ancestor does not establish infection in this tumour group.
Acute leukemia of immature T-lineage blood/marrow cells; T-cell lineage alone does not establish an immune mechanism axis.
Malignancy of blood-vessel endothelium; cutaneous origin with direct skin destruction occurs in roughly half. Other sites vary across subtypes; breast has no axis.
Inherited hemoglobin variant causing generally mild microcytic anemia; no common extrahematologic damage.
